whelix.title: AI Engineer Intern
bullets: Designed and shipped a production multi-agent AI platform for a robotics startup from the ground up, built directly on the raw \textbf{Gemini SDK} (no agent framework) to retain full control over the tool-use loop — architecting a single orchestrator agent that dynamically delegates to \textbf{three} specialized sub-agents at runtime via a dedicated routing tool, re-verifying authorization on every delegation to gate two CEO-only specialists entrusted with live sales-pipeline and fundraising data, deployed on \textbf{Google Cloud Run}.

Integrated the platform across \textbf{three} external systems (Notion, Confluence, and Google Workspace — Gmail, Calendar, and Chat) via \textbf{26 custom tool functions} for structured data read/write, and engineered a two-layer memory architecture — live structured-fact writes plus GCS-backed conversation logging with nightly LLM-driven reconciliation — enabling stateless webhook calls to sustain coherent multi-turn context.

Automated \textbf{two} recurring company workflows end-to-end (meeting-notes ingestion and agenda generation) via scheduled Cloud Run triggers, and independently authored an \textbf{11-database} knowledge-architecture plan to consolidate the company's fragmented internal documentation into a single unified system of record.

Served as the sole engineer on this initiative, reporting directly to Whelix's CEO and owning the system end-to-end from architecture through production deployment — a level of ownership atypical for an internship role.

basf.title: Digitalization Intern, Asia-Pacific Monomers
bullets: Identified a critical intelligence gap in BASF's MDI/TDI pricing process: marketing analysts were manually monitoring 3--4 news sources across two languages to track demand signals — an error-prone process feeding VP-level pricing decisions in a market where BASF holds significant pricing authority in China.

Designed and deployed an \textbf{end-to-end LLM-powered (GPT-4o) market intelligence engine} that automated bilingual news monitoring, extraction, and synthesis — replacing the manual workflow entirely and delivering structured weekly and monthly insight reports directly consumed by pricing decision-makers.
Partnered with marketing stakeholders to ensure output format matched executive reporting requirements, driving adoption from day one and eliminating the need for manual news triage across the team.

Supported \textbf{8+ additional digitalization initiatives} across supply chain, EHS, and production, serving as the technical translator between business requirements and deployed solutions using Python, KNIME, and Power BI.

Drove the development of a plant equipment inspection system by regularly visiting chemical plants and speaking directly with on-site workers, grounding a desk-based digitalization effort in real operational needs.
Centralized \textbf{Technical Data Sheets} across factories and languages, improving consistency and ensuring timely updates for products across multiple plants and regions.
Automated daily and monthly \textbf{ICTP} data updates and preprocessing, providing a reliable, up-to-date data foundation for downstream business analysis.
Optimized sales and analysis dashboards in \textbf{Power BI}, translating complex data into a clear format accessible to a wide range of business audiences.

media_center.title: Media Center, Nanjing University Undergraduate Admissions Office
bullets: Led end-to-end production of \textbf{10+ video campaigns} on NJU's official Bilibili account (60,000 followers), managing cross-functional teams across scripting, directing, and post-production.

Executive producer for videos accumulating \textbf{30,000+ views}; served as lead actor in a 4-episode campus life series exceeding \textbf{20,000 views} — demonstrating comfort with high-visibility, audience-facing communication.

thesis_uplift.title: Thesis: Decision-Focused Uplift Modeling for AUUC Maximization
bullets: Designed and implemented Decision-Focused Uplift Modeling (DFUM), a training framework that closes the gap between prediction accuracy and AUUC-measured ranking decision quality in individual treatment effect estimation — combining a binary cross-entropy prediction loss with a differentiable, softmax-weighted decision loss that directly optimizes the downstream treatment-ranking objective, motivated by an integer linear programming formulation of budget-constrained treatment assignment

Benchmarked DFUM against S-Learner, X-Learner, UpliftRank, and Generalized Random Forests across a 13M-row public ad-incrementality dataset (Criteo), achieving an average 2%+ AUUC improvement over 20 independent seeds per configuration while maintaining stable performance across a swept trade-off hyperparameter

research_assistant.title: Research Assistant, Nanjing University
bullets: Co-authored a comprehensive survey on \textbf{decision-focused learning}, single-handedly drafting the introduction and benchmark sections and framing \textbf{100+ papers} into a unified taxonomy.
Delivered weekly literature briefings to a \textbf{15-member} lab group, synthesizing advances in decision-focused learning and modern causal-inference methods for a mixed-background audience.

ccf_contest.title: CCF Big Data \& Computing Intelligence Contest \textnormal{(1,557 participants)}
bullets: Led a team to a 2nd-place finish (out of 1,557 teams) in the CCF Big Data \& Computing Intelligence Contest (BDCI 2023), designing an end-to-end forecast-stock-allocate decision pipeline for an omnichannel fresh-grocery inventory optimization challenge

Built a demand-forecasting model on top of the Kaggle M5 competition's top-1 approach — engineering price, promotion, sales-lag, and calendar features, then training a multi-window ensemble (30/90/365-day and full-history LightGBM models) to jointly capture short- and long-term sales patterns across SKUs with heterogeneous listing dates

Designed a nonlinear safety-stock formula that allocates proportionally more buffer inventory to low-volume, harder-to-forecast SKUs, and a greedy heuristic for front-/back-store inventory allocation under service-level constraints — trading exact profit-optimal solutions (computationally intractable within the contest's time limit) for fast, near-optimal heuristics

promptprompt.title: PromptPrompt: AI-Powered Prompt Optimizer
bullets: Built the LLM API integration layer for a team course project (PromptPrompt, an AI-powered prompt optimizer) — implementing the connector to Groq's API and structuring it to support extensibility to Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic as alternate backends for the optimizer's multi-step prompt-refinement calls.

Designed and implemented a user authentication module for the CLI tool; later proposed and led the team's decision to cut it in favor of a simplified local API-key storage flow, prioritizing a tighter, shippable MVP scope over unnecessary complexity ahead of the deadline.

Served as the team's primary debugger across teammates' modules — including the CLI interaction layer and evaluation scripts — helping the group ship an integrated, working tool rather than disconnected pieces.

social_bot_detection.title: The First Social Group Intelligent Algorithm Competition
bullets: Identified fake social media accounts from a 2,500+ entry multilingual dataset with missing values and mixed data types, applying \textbf{ResNet18} to extract features from profile images.
Built and tuned an ensemble of GBDT, neural network, and Transformer models, achieving \textbf{>80\% prediction accuracy} on held-out data.

weibo_prediction.title: Model Prediction of Weibo Search Popularity
bullets: Independently authored and published a peer-reviewed paper predicting Weibo search popularity (\href{https://doi.org/10.54254/2755-2721/55/20241397}{DOI: 10.54254/2755-2721/55/20241397}), owning the full research pipeline solo.
Engineered a custom Python web crawler to collect raw social data, then cleaned and modeled it in R with a neural network to predict key engagement features.

bullets: Authored an independent literature review (course project) on prompt engineering theory and applications across LLM tasks, synthesizing the emerging literature into a structured account of current techniques and open challenges.
